name: Komine Shizue
source:
She is the female doctor at the only clinic in Komine Village, where the protagonist visits. She is an adult woman who warmly watches over and encourages not only Chiri-nee, Natsuko-nee, and Akina-nee, who aspire to be nurses, but also the protagonist himself.

She mistakes the protagonist, who has returned to the village after ten years, for his father, and it seems there was something between her and the protagonist's father in the past.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080415135100/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/oneboku/top_off.html]archived official site[/url]]
